title: Autonomy ledger
description: Per ticket-class autonomy levels (L0-L4) and rolling metrics. Autonomy is earned per class, never globally; a regression demotes the class, not the harness. mode:requires-expertise work is pinned at L0 forever and never appears here. Written only by scripts/update-ledger.py via scripts/commit-state.sh (hash-checked). Unfreezing a class or clearing global_freeze is a human edit via PR/commit-state.

global_freeze.description: Manual global auto-merge kill switch inside the ledger. Independent of the AUTO_MERGE_FROZEN repo variable (set by judge-evals on a verdict flip); the auto-merge gate requires BOTH to be off.

updated_at.description: Last time update-ledger.py wrote this file. null only in the initial stub.

classes.description: Keyed by ticket class = the class:* label value on the sprint issue ('unclassified' when absent).

level.description: L0 human-authored, L1 agent PR + human reviews spec+code, L2 spec fast-path auto-approved, L3 auto-merge on all-green + 24h revert window, L4 auto-merge + self-selected tickets (promotion capped at L3 until L4 machinery ships).

consecutive_clean_merges.description: Merged agent PRs since the last level transition with zero change-requests, zero human commits on the branch, and no detected post-merge human edits. Reset by any transition or any non-clean closed PR.

change_requested_streak.description: Consecutive closed agent PRs that received a human CHANGES_REQUESTED review. 2 triggers demotion.

judge_first_pass.description: PRs whose earliest agent-ops/code-judge commit status was success, over closed agent PRs since the last level transition.

coverage_trips.description: Times the coverage-delta check failed on this class since the last level transition. Any trip blocks promotion.

guardrail_overrides.description: Times a human overrode a guardrail (admin-merged past a failing required agent check) since the last level transition. Any override blocks promotion.

frozen.description: Class-level auto-merge freeze (set by a postmortem demotion). Cleared only by a human.

history.description: Append-only transition log. evidence_url also dedupes postmortem demotions: a postmortem already cited here is never applied twice.

reason.description: e.g. 'promotion: 10 clean merges, judge first-pass 10/10', 'demotion: postmortem caused_by_class', 'demotion: 2 consecutive change-requested PRs'
